title: GitHub Pages Informative Site Redesign

localization.description: Existing standalone HTML landing page at site root — redesign hero, features, providers, and CTA sections
Landing page styles — refresh for unified brand identity
Landing page JS — minimal updates for new sections
Collapse 14-section nav to ~6 sections; update theme palette and logo; remove mkdocstrings plugin (M9); add custom_dir for overrides
Rewrite mkdocs landing as concept-oriented hub with chapter cards pointing to wiki for deep dives
Rewrite 7 chapter overviews as concept introductions (what/why) with 'deep dive in the Wiki →' CTAs; possibly consolidate from 7 to 5
Already exists and is well-written; add to mkdocs nav prominently, minor edits for flow
Add 'minimal config' section at top; collapse advanced env vars into expandable sections
Curate to 3-4 showcase tools for informative site; full catalog → wiki link
Existing assets; add favicon.ico, social-card.png for OG tags
New: custom CSS for hero sections, social cards; custom partials for footer/header
Update: remove mkdocstrings install step (M9); possibly add social card generation
Create: declare mkdocs-material + extensions as docs build dependencies

hypotheses.statement: A two-tier architecture (landing HTML at root + streamlined mkdocs at /docs/) is the right structure, and it already exists — the redesign is a content/theme refresh, not a platform migration
The post-FEAT-801 Pages inventory (~30-40 pages) is small enough that the nav can collapse from 14 sections to 5-6 without losing content — the bulk of the 175 entries move to wiki
The biggest content gap is beginner tutorials ('build your first chatbot/agent/tool') — getting-started.md covers installation but there are no code walkthroughs
Brand identity unification (logo, favicon, social card, consistent icon usage) is a distinct workstream from nav/content restructuring and can run in parallel

constraints.description: Must wait for FEAT-801 (all 8 tasks) + M9 cut-over before merging to dev — TASK-5172 mass-moves ~100+ docs/ files
mkdocs Material stack stays — no platform migration (per source.md)
Two-surface doctrine: Pages = informative, Wiki = technical reference — never copy, always cross-link
Existing guides, examples, branding, postman collections must be preserved (per source.md)
No testable Python code — this is content and design work only
The landing page overlay pattern (cp -R landing/. site/) must be preserved — it is the deployment mechanism

unknowns.question: Should the landing page (landing/index.html) be redesigned from scratch or iteratively updated? It already has Hero/Features/Install/QuickStart/Architecture/Providers sections.
How many beginner tutorials should be created as part of this feature vs. deferred? (First chatbot, first agent, first tool, RAG pipeline, deployment)
Should the chapter overview pages be consolidated (7 → 5) or kept 1:1 with wiki sections?

scope_summary: Redesign the GitHub Pages mkdocs site as a product landing/informative site after FEAT-801 migrates technical docs to the wiki. Three workstreams: (1) Landing page refresh — update hero, value prop, provider showcase, getting-started CTA; unify brand identity (logo, favicon, social card). (2) Mkdocs restructuring — collapse 14-section nav to ~6 newcomer-friendly sections; rewrite chapter overviews as concept pages with wiki cross-links; surface getting-started.md; create requirements-docs.txt. (3) Content creation — beginner tutorials (first chatbot, first agent), curated tools showcase, 'minimal config' quick-start block. Preserves the existing two-tier deployment (landing HTML at root, mkdocs at /docs/) and the Material theme.
